player_prompt.intro:
Welcome to Frozen Lake!

You are represented by 'P' on the grid.
Grid symbols:
  ' ' = Frozen surface (safe to walk on)
  'H' = Hole (fall in and lose!)
  'G' = Goal (reach this to win!)
  'P' = Your current position

Available actions: up, down, left, right (or w, a, s, d)
Type your action as: [up], [down], [left], [right] or [w], [a], [s], [d]

Objective: Navigate from the start (top-left) to the goal (bottom-right) without falling into any holes!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Tiragalo yeo e sa tsebjego '{action}'. Diriša godimo, tlase, ka go le letshadi, ka letona goba w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: O ile wa leka go šutha {action} eupša o ile wa thula leboto!

game_action.moved: O ile wa tsamaya {action} go ya poso ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Ke a go lebogiša! O fihleletše pakane ya gago!
outcome.fell_in_hole: You fell into a hole! Game over. You completed {pct}% of the journey to the goal.
outcome.turn_limit: O fihleletše tekanyetšo ya go retologa! Papadi e fedile. O phethile {pct}% ya leeto la go fihla mo o yago gona.
